plan.title: Frontier adoption 2026-11-18: goals, metrics and follow-up verification
plan.goal: Adopt the owner-approved frontier recommendations and verify each against its measured baseline 14 days after it is ON.

items.name: 1 - Constrained decoding (fe-2ab16cb00ee3)
items.goal: Machine-read local outputs are always well formed.
items.validation_goal: Share of machine-read local runs with a format failure or TRUNCATED is at most 1%; no new TRUNCATED on schema runs. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 1a - grammar + ignore_eos guard (llama.cpp b12489)
items.goal: No caller sends grammar/json_schema together with ignore_eos.
items.validation_goal: scripts/testing/test-constrained-decoding.py passes; rg finds 0 combined callers. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 2 - Owned-path merge gate (lanes-owned-scope-gate)
items.validation_goal: 0 out-of-scope merges; at most 1 false refusal per 20 lands. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 3 - Checks command in the brief (yt-checks-over-plans-goal)
items.goal: Done is test-proven; fewer review rounds.
items.validation_goal: 100% of briefs carry a checks field; mean aq-land review rounds at most 1.5. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 4 - Token caps + stop condition (lanes-token-caps-in-brief)
items.validation_goal: At least 20% fewer codex tokens per landed PR with no rise in review rounds. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 5 - Skill eval + prune (yt-skill-eval-prune)
items.validation_goal: At least 30% fewer skills with no eval regression. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 6 - LLM01 boundary audit (fe-a2a4a2caa18a)
items.goal: Every LLM-output to shell/Nix/disk boundary is validated.
items.validation_goal: 100% of boundaries enumerated; 0 open findings. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 7 - systemd egress limits (FE-8)
items.goal: Untrusted units are pinned to the network they need.
items.validation_goal: All MCP/untrusted units restricted; 0 unexpected denials; 0 health regressions. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 8 - Functional eval metric (FE-2a)
items.goal: A non-saturated, reproducible quality metric exists before any prompt optimizer.
items.validation_goal: Baseline below 90%, repeat-run variance at most 3 points. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 9 - Hook smoke test (Claude Code 2.1.326 hook semantics)
items.goal: PreToolUse hooks still block and rewrite correctly.
items.validation_goal: Smoke test PASS recorded. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 10 - llama.cpp b12498 slot fix
items.goal: Pin includes the slot fix if our architecture needs it.
items.validation_goal: flake.lock rev compared with b12498; decision recorded at the next scheduled rebuild. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 11 - arXiv memory/verifier papers (local slice)
items.validation_goal: Takeaways file written; at most 1 adopted follow-up. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 12 - lean-ctx shell_security
items.goal: Agent harness tools are never blocked.
items.validation_goal: 0 BLOCKED lines for harness tools in hook output and agent logs. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.

items.name: 13 - Activation of developed features
items.goal: Every merged feature is ON or carries a dated deferral.
items.validation_goal: The activation audit table shows 100% ON or deferred. Review 14 days after ON (VERIFY.md); global checkpoint 2026-12-02.
